question: What ash content (as received) and net heating value does the Ordos lignite have?
rendered:
The document "Novel Alkali Extraction-Acid Precipitation-Chlorination Distillation Method for Co-extraction of Humic Substances and Germanium (Ge) from Ge-Rich Lignite" contains the information about the Ordos lignite.

Table 1 of this document shows the proximate and ultimate analysis of the Ordos lignite. The ash content (as received) is 31.61% and the net heating value is 14.7 MJ/kg.
